tests.coverage: NOT VERIFIED (pytest-cov not installed in the image)

resilience.throttle_fail_open_live: CONFIRMED (6 wrong logins during Redis outage: all 401, no 429)

findings.problem: articulation_points uses recursive Tarjan DFS; overflows Python recursion limit on components deeper than ~1000 nodes, raising RecursionError on every analytics reader despite ANALYTICS_GRAPH_NODE_CAP=2000.
findings.impact: Any case graph with connected depth >~1000 returns 500 from summary/centrality/communities/patterns/network-dna; documented exact-vs-approximate contract broken between 1000 and 2000 nodes.
findings.reproduction: Inserted 1500 entities/3000-edge cycle; all analytics endpoints returned 500 after ~6.8s; log shows RecursionError at graph.py:122.
findings.recommendation: Implement iterative Tarjan (explicit stack) or otherwise bound recursion deterministically; add a >1000-node regression test.

findings.problem: No case-scoped Neo4j deletion on case teardown; test runs project test cases into the live graph store.
findings.impact: Neo4j now holds 597 nodes across 61 case_ids and 1058 edges while PostgreSQL has 1 case; the projection is not consistent with the source of truth over time.
findings.reproduction: Run backend/tests/api against live stack; MATCH (n:Entity) RETURN count(DISTINCT n.case_id) shows growth.
findings.recommendation: Delete projections on case deletion; clean graph store in test teardown or use a dedicated test graph database.

findings.problem: Objects written to storage before DB insert and never deleted on insert failure or case deletion; no DELETE endpoint for evidence.
findings.impact: ~60 orphaned objects in the bucket with no DB rows; unbounded storage growth.
findings.reproduction: List bucket after running API/evidence tests: orphan objects remain.
findings.recommendation: Compensating delete on failure; scoped deletion on case teardown; optional reconciliation job.
findings.evidence: boto3 listing: 66 objects vs 5 evidence rows

findings.problem: GET /audit-logs requires only PERM_AUDIT_READ (granted to INVESTIGATOR) with no case ownership restriction; optional case_id filter is unscoped.
findings.impact: Any investigator can read audit metadata (login events, mutations) across all cases and users.
findings.recommendation: Scope to owned cases for non-admin; ADMIN sees all.

findings.problem: SECRET_KEY defaults to placeholder 'change-me'; production placeholder guard only runs when APP_ENV==='production' while APP_ENV defaults to 'development'. REDIS_URL not covered.
findings.impact: Misconfigured production can silently run with known signing secret.
findings.reproduction: Set APP_ENV empty/development with placeholder secrets -> starts fine.
findings.recommendation: Validate placeholders in any non-development/test env; include Redis.

findings.problem: Throttle fails open on Redis errors and is keyed only by username (no IP).
findings.impact: Brute force when Redis is down; trivial account-lockout DoS for any username (5 bad logins).
findings.reproduction: DROP redis -> wrong-password attempts not throttled; or 5 bad logins lock the account.
findings.recommendation: IP+username keying, exponential backoff, optional fail-closed.
findings.evidence: throttle.py + test_throttle.py:54-58 + LIVE: 6 bad logins during Redis outage -> all 401, no 429

findings.problem: Stateless HMAC tokens with no logout/refresh/revocation; jti never stored/checked.
findings.impact: Leaked tokens valid full 30-minute window.
findings.reproduction: Inspect auth endpoints: no revoke/logout exists.
findings.recommendation: Optional server-side revocation via Redis jti or refresh tokens.

findings.problem: Entity create and data-source create are SELECT-then-INSERT without on_conflict; ingest job has no (case_id, evidence_file_id) uniqueness.
findings.impact: Concurrent duplicate creates can raise IntegrityError (job marked failed) or 500; redundant ingest jobs.
findings.recommendation: Use on_conflict_do_nothing + refetch; unique ingest-job key.

findings.problem: Each analytics run persists ~55 findings with no cross-run dedup/retention.
findings.impact: Findings table grows unboundedly (2 runs -> 110 rows), review queue inflates.
findings.recommendation: Link findings to run_id with retention policy or collapse unchanged signals.

findings.problem: caseService.list fetches server limit/offset (default 100) then filters search/status client-side and sets total=items.length after filtering.
findings.impact: Search/filter miss matches beyond page 1 and every consumer of `total` (cases pagination, dashboard stats) gets wrong counts in real mode.
findings.reproduction: Real API with >100 cases; search a title on page 2+.
findings.recommendation: Server-side search/status params; true server total.

findings.problem: Mock upload returns status 'pending'; real backend returns 'stored'; Ingest button only renders for 'stored'.
findings.impact: Default mock demo cannot perform upload->ingest; core SIH pipeline step invisible in the browser.
findings.reproduction: Default mode, upload a CSV, no Ingest action on the new row.
findings.recommendation: Mock returns 'stored'; add demo ingest affordance.

findings.problem: /app/audit has no route-level permission guard; palette offers it to every role (relies on backend 403).
findings.impact: VIEWER clicks audit and lands on an error state after a real 403.
findings.reproduction: Login as VIEWER, open command palette, click 'Open audit log'.
findings.recommendation: Gate route + palette action on audit.read.

findings.problem: useRunAnalytics/useIngestEvidence do not invalidate networkDna/communities/priorities/strength/patterns/hypotheses/centrality keys.
findings.impact: Analytics panels show stale (up to 60s) data after run or ingest.
findings.reproduction: Run analysis, watch DNA/communities panels not refresh.
findings.recommendation: Extend invalidation to all analytics-derived keys.

findings.problem: Two identical cases.list({limit:100}) requests under different keys; Open/In-progress/Closed stats computed from a 100-case page.
findings.impact: Duplicate network call; stats undercount beyond 100 cases.
findings.reproduction: Network tab in real mode shows two GET /cases.
findings.recommendation: Single shared query; server totals.

findings.problem: Module-level mock state mutated by tests with no reset in beforeEach; one test asserts 'pending' cementing the F02 divergence.
findings.impact: Order-dependent test flakiness; test verifies mock-specific wrong behavior.
findings.reproduction: Re-run query/mock tests in different orders.
findings.recommendation: Add resetMockState(); assert 'stored'.

findings.problem: CaseCreateRequest.status typed as full CaseStatus incl 'archived'; backend rejects 'archived' (422). Three status sets exist across backend/contract-doc/TS.
findings.impact: Type permits an invalid value; contract drift.
findings.reproduction: If UI sent archived in create, backend 422.
findings.recommendation: Narrow create/update to open|in_progress|closed; keep archived read-only; sync doc.

findings.problem: 'eigenvector' centrality tab; backend never emits it and mock seed has none -> always-empty tab.
findings.impact: Dead tab visible to judges.
findings.recommendation: Remove or implement.

findings.problem: Status label map lacks backend 'parsed' and includes mock-only 'ingested'.
findings.impact: parsed labeled 'Stored'; misleading.
findings.reproduction: Real mode: ingest then list evidence.
findings.recommendation: Align map to backend+reconciled mock.

findings.problem: Hardcoded data-source chips diverge from backend-persisted arbitrary strings; mock ignores dataSource.
findings.impact: Same file shows different source in mock vs real.
findings.reproduction: Upload same CSV in both modes.
findings.recommendation: Shared data-source vocabulary / derive from record.

findings.problem: Unused (0 imports) components advertised by design-system.md:50.
findings.impact: Dead code; doc drift.
findings.recommendation: Remove or adopt; wire ErrorBoundary route-wide.

findings.problem: No .env* ignore rule for the frontend.
findings.impact: A committed .env would leak.
findings.recommendation: Add *.env and !.env.example.

findings.problem: Bearer token stored in localStorage (XSS-exfiltratable).
findings.impact: Standard SPA tradeoff; permission re-fetch on boot mitigates.
findings.recommendation: Consider httpOnly cookie or short-lived in-memory token.

findings.problem: Plaintext demo credentials shipped and rendered (mock mode).
findings.impact: Bundle-visible demo creds.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable for demo; gate behind demo flag (already is).

findings.problem: Cancel keeps previously selected file.
findings.impact: Stale pick on reopen.
findings.recommendation: Clear picked on dialog close.

findings.problem: '12 code-split route chunks' claim; actual build has 35 JS assets / 16+ lazy chunks.
findings.impact: Stale claim.
findings.recommendation: Correct numbers.

findings.problem: 8 Inter font files ~210KB shipped.
findings.impact: Initial load cost.
findings.recommendation: Subsetting/preload.

findings.problem: 'No access to this case' reused on global audit 403.
findings.impact: Confusing copy.
findings.recommendation: Per-context copy.

findings.problem: Error envelope '{status,code,detail}' and CaseStatus list do not match actual backend/TS ('{error:{code,message}}', open|in_progress|closed+read-only archived).
findings.impact: Doc misleads new frontend/backend integrators.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate from OpenAPI.

findings.problem: README says 'frontend/ placeholder - no implementation yet'.
findings.impact: Stale repository overview.
findings.recommendation: Update README to reflect shipped frontend.

findings.problem: Lists z-index tokens absent from globals.css; claims no raw hex in JSX, violated at dashboard.tsx:84 and cyto-graph.tsx:10-19.
findings.impact: Doc/code drift.
findings.recommendation: Sync or centralize colors.

findings.problem: ILIKE query with unescaped %/_ wildcards; display_value unindexed (full scan).
findings.impact: Broad-match DoS at scale.
findings.recommendation: Escape wildcards; pg_trgm GIN index.

findings.problem: Relationship type interpolated into Cypher; safe only via DB allowlist.
findings.impact: Fragile; regression could reopen injection.
findings.recommendation: Validate type allowlist before interpolation.

findings.problem: No CSP/HSTS/COOP/COEP/Permissions-Policy.
findings.impact: Missing defense-in-depth headers.
findings.recommendation: Add CSP + HSTS for production.

findings.problem: Prod image installs .[dev] (pytest/ruff/mypy).
findings.impact: Larger image + attack surface.
findings.recommendation: Split dev/prod install.

findings.problem: Data-fix migration downgrade destructive; each replica runs upgrade head on start.
findings.impact: Downgrade data loss; concurrent-replica migration risk.
findings.recommendation: Document single-writer; warn on downgrade.

findings.problem: Loads full accessible case-id set into memory before paginating.
findings.impact: Unbounded memory for admin over many cases.
findings.recommendation: Push pagination into SQL.

findings.problem: No memory/CPU limits; minio/minio:latest and minio/mc:latest unpinned.
findings.impact: Neo4j at 822MB unconstrained; OOM risk on laptops; mutable tags.
findings.recommendation: Add resource limits; pin image tags.
